Class DefaultManagedTaskScheduler

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.ConcurrentTaskExecutor
org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.ConcurrentTaskScheduler
org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.DefaultManagedTaskScheduler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Executor, InitializingBean, AsyncTaskExecutor, TaskExecutor, SchedulingTaskExecutor, TaskScheduler
public class DefaultManagedTaskScheduler extends ConcurrentTaskScheduler implements InitializingBean
JNDI-based variant of ConcurrentTaskScheduler, performing a default lookup for JSR-236's "java:comp/DefaultManagedScheduledExecutorService" in a Jakarta EE environment. Expected to be exposed as a bean, in particular as the default lookup happens in the standard InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() callback.

注意：该类并非严格基于 JSR-236；它可以与 JNDI 中找到的任何常规 ScheduledExecutorService 配合使用。 实际的适配到 ManagedScheduledExecutorService 发生在基类 ConcurrentTaskScheduler 本身中。

Since:
4.0
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

      public void setResourceRef(boolean resourceRef)
      设置是否在 Jakarta EE 容器中执行查找，即如果 JNDI 名称中尚未包含该前缀，是否需要添加"java:comp/env/"。PersistenceAnnotationBeanPostProcessor 的默认值为"true"。
      See Also:
      • JndiLocatorSupport.setResourceRef(boolean)

    • setJndiName

      public void setJndiName(String jndiName)
      Specify a JNDI name of the Executor to delegate to, replacing the default JNDI name "java:comp/DefaultManagedScheduledExecutorService".

      这可以是完全限定的 JNDI 名称，或者如果将"resourceRef"设置为"true"，则是相对于当前环境命名上下文的相对 JNDI 名称。

      See Also:
      • ConcurrentTaskExecutor.setConcurrentExecutor(Executor)
